finalText.titleEn: Explain DNA Replication with a Simple Model
finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die Bedeutung der DNA-Replikation erklären und an einem einfachen Modell zeigen, dass bei semikonservativer Replikation jeder neue DNA-Doppelstrang einen ursprünglichen und einen neu gebildeten Einzelstrang enthält.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the significance of DNA replication and use a simple model to show that, in semiconservative replication, each new DNA double strand contains one original and one newly formed single strand.

synthesis.synthesizedBy: Codex technical integration of actual sealed A/B science; model version not exposed
synthesis.rationaleDe: Technische Zusammenführung der echten unabhängig versiegelten A-/B-Erstbewertungen des gleichen vollständigen aktuellen bilingualen Ziels, nativer Seite und Quellen-/Bild-/Kontexteingänge. Alle originalen Records, Run-IDs und Campaign-IDs bleiben exakt. Keine neue fachliche Prüfung oder menschliche Freigabe. A: The bilingual goal explains replication significance through the same simple semiconservative copying model. The prerequisite DNA-Aufbau supplies structural context. BW physical24/printed22 clause3.3.2(3) explicitly asks for simple-model duplication capability; the added BW support is a partial operationalisation, not complete coverage of the whole structure/information-storage bullet or a requirement for advanced enzyme mechanisms. Significance and strand tracing explain one DNA copying relation. The fresh round extends that same model; it does not import enzyme kinetics, a separate inheritance routine or mitosis assessment. B: Current German/English goal states the significance and strand-material invariant of one semiconservative copying model. Added BW applicability is supported by the actual printed22/physical24 standard3.3.2(3): DNA properties include duplication ability explained on a simple model. Semiconservative replication is a valid bounded model operationalisation of that component; this goal alone does not cover the whole DNA structure/information-storage bullet. Existing structure prerequisite and SekI scope remain appropriate.
synthesis.rationaleEn: Technical factual synthesis of genuine sealed independent A/B first-pass judgments over identical whole current bilingual goals, native pages and source/image/context inputs. Original records, runs and campaign identifiers are retained exactly. No new scientific review or human approval. A: In semiconservative DNA replication, each existing single strand acts as a template for a complementary new strand. Original strands enter separate daughter DNA molecules; template copying can preserve sequence information even as original material becomes differently distributed. B: Complementary template copying preserves DNA sequence information, while each daughter model contains one original and one new strand after a copying round.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Bei semikonservativer DNA-Replikation dient jeder vorhandene Einzelstrang als Vorlage für einen komplementären neuen Strang. Die ursprünglichen Stränge gelangen in getrennte Tochter-DNA-Moleküle; Vorlagenkopie kann die Sequenzinformation bewahren, obwohl sich die Verteilung des ursprünglichen Materials ändert.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: In semiconservative DNA replication, each existing single strand acts as a template for a complementary new strand. Original strands enter separate daughter DNA molecules; template copying can preserve sequence information even as original material becomes differently distributed.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die lernende Person baut aus markierten Ausgangssträngen mit einer gegebenen Paarungs- und Richtungslegende zwei passende Tochtermodelle, verfolgt die ursprünglichen Stränge und begründet die Bedeutung dieser Kopie für die Weitergabe genetischer Information.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: Using a supplied pairing and direction legend, the learner constructs two appropriate daughter models from labelled initial strands, traces the original strands and justifies the significance of copying for transmitting genetic information.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Bei einer weiteren, frisch dargestellten Kopierrunde ordnet die lernende Person die nur am Startmolekül angebrachten Markierungen den vier Tochtermodellen zu und begründet, weshalb fehlende ursprüngliche Materialmarkierungen keinen Verlust der kopierten Sequenzinformation bedeuten.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: In a further copying round presented as fresh material, the learner assigns labels attached only to the original starting molecule across four daughter models and justifies why missing original material labels do not mean that copied sequence information has been lost.
